4: import {Math} from "../math/Math.sol";

6: library P256 {
7:     struct JPoint {
8:         uint256 x;
9:         uint256 y;
10:         uint256 z;
11:     }

13:     uint256 private constant P = 0xFFFFFFFF00000001000000000000000000000000FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF;
14:     uint256 private constant A = 0xFFFFFFFF00000001000000000000000000000000FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFC;
15:     uint256 private constant B = 0x5AC635D8AA3A93E7B3EBBD55769886BC651D06B0CC53B0F63BCE3C3E27D2604B;
16:     uint256 private constant GX = 0x6B17D1F2E12C4247F8BCE6E563A440F277037D812DEB33A0F4A13945D898C296;

18:     uint256 private constant N = 0xFFFFFFFF00000000FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFBCE6FAADA7179E84F3B9CAC2FC632551;
19:     uint256 private constant HALF_N = N / 2;

21:     function verify(bytes32 h, bytes32 r, bytes32 s, bytes32 qx, bytes32 qy) internal view returns (bool) {
22:         (bool valid, bool supported) = _tryVerifyNative(h, r, s, qx, qy);
23:         if (supported) {
24:             return valid;
25:         }
26:         return verifySolidity(h, r, s, qx, qy);
27:     }

29:     function verifyNative(bytes32 h, bytes32 r, bytes32 s, bytes32 qx, bytes32 qy) internal view returns (bool) {
30:         (bool valid, bool supported) = _tryVerifyNative(h, r, s, qx, qy);
31:         if (!supported) {
32:             revert("P256: precompile not available");
33:         }
34:         return valid;

37:     function _tryVerifyNative(bytes32 h, bytes32 r, bytes32 s, bytes32 qx, bytes32 qy) private view returns (bool valid, bool supported) {
38:         if (!_isProperSignature(r, s) || !isValidPublicKey(qx, qy)) {
39:             return (false, true);
40:         }
41: 
42:         (bool success, bytes memory data) = address(0x100).staticcall(
43:             abi.encode(h, r, s, qx, qy)
44:         );
45: 
46:         if (success && data.length == 0x20) {
47:             return (abi.decode(data, (bool)), true);
48:         }
49: 
50:         return (false, false);
51:     }

53:     function verifySolidity(bytes32 h, bytes32 r, bytes32 s, bytes32 qx, bytes32 qy) internal view returns (bool) {
54:         if (!_isProperSignature(r, s) || !isValidPublicKey(qx, qy)) {
55:             return false;
56:         }
57: 
58:         JPoint[16] memory points = _preComputeJacobianPoints(uint256(qx), uint256(qy));
59: 
60:         uint256 w = Math.invModPrime(uint256(s), N);
61:         uint256 u1 = mulmod(uint256(h), w, N);
62:         uint256 u2 = mulmod(uint256(r), w, N);
63: 
64:         (uint256 x, ) = _jMultShamir(points, u1, u2);
65: 
66:         return addmod(x % N, N - uint256(r), N) == 0;
67:     }

69:     function recovery(bytes32 h, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) internal view returns (bytes32 x, bytes32 y) {
70:         if (!_isProperSignature(r, s) || v > 1) {
71:             return (bytes32(0), bytes32(0));
72:         }
73: 
74:         uint256 rr = uint256(r);
75:         uint256 y2 = addmod(addmod(mulmod(mulmod(rr, rr, P), rr, P), mulmod(A, rr, P), P), B, P);
76:         uint256 yy = Math.modExp(y2, (P + 1) / 4, P);
77: 
78:         if (mulmod(yy, yy, P) != y2) {
79:             return (bytes32(0), bytes32(0));
80:         }
81: 
82:         if (uint8(yy & 1) != (1 - v)) {
83:             yy = P - yy;
84:         }
85: 
86:         JPoint[16] memory points = _preComputeJacobianPoints(rr, yy);

88:         uint256 w = Math.invModPrime(rr, N);
89:         uint256 u1 = mulmod(N - uint256(h), w, N);
90:         uint256 u2 = mulmod(uint256(s), w, N);
91: 
92:         (uint256 rx, uint256 ry) = _jMultShamir(points, u1, u2);
93: 
94:         return (bytes32(rx), bytes32(ry));
95:     }

97:     function isValidPublicKey(bytes32 x, bytes32 y) internal pure returns (bool result) {
98:         assembly ("memory-safe") {
99:             let p := 0xFFFFFFFF00000001000000000000000000000000FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
100:             let a := 0xFFFFFFFF00000001000000000000000000000000FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFC
101:             let b := 0x5AC635D8AA3A93E7B3EBBD55769886BC651D06B0CC53B0F63BCE3C3E27D2604B
102: 
103:             let xVal := mload(add(x, 0x20))
104:             let yVal := mload(add(y, 0x20))
105: 
106:             // x < p and y < p
107:             if or(iszero(lt(xVal, p)), iszero(lt(yVal, p))) {
108:                 result := 0
109:                 return(0x00, 0x00)
110:             }
111: 
112:             // y^2 mod p
113:             let y2 := mulmod(yVal, yVal, p)
114: 
115:             // x^3 + a*x + b mod p
116:             let x3 := mulmod(mulmod(xVal, xVal, p), xVal, p)
117:             let ax := mulmod(a, xVal, p)
118:             let rhs := addmod(addmod(x3, ax, p), b, p)
119:

121:         }

130:     function _affineFromJacobian(uint256 jx, uint256 jy, uint256 jz) private view returns (uint256 ax, uint256 ay) {
131:         if (jz == 0) {
132:             return (0, 0);
133:         }

135:         uint256 zinv = Math.invModPrime(jz, P);

139:             let zzinv := mulmod(zinv, zinv, p)

145:     function _jAdd(JPoint memory p1, uint256 x2, uint256 y2, uint256 z2) private pure returns (uint256 rx, uint256 ry, uint256 rz) {
146:         assembly ("memory-safe") {
147:             let p := 0xFFFFFFFF00000001000000000000000000000000FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
148:             let a := 0xFFFFFFFF00000001000000000000000000000000FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFC
149:             let x1 := mload(p1)
150:             let y1 := mload(add(p1, 0x20))
151:             let z1 := mload(add(p1, 0x40))
152: 
153:             let zz1 := mulmod(z1, z1, p)
154:             let zz2 := mulmod(z2, z2, p)
155:             let u1 := mulmod(x1, zz2, p)
156:             let u2 := mulmod(x2, zz1, p)
157:             let z2z2z2 := mulmod(z2, zz2, p)
158:             let z1z1z1 := mulmod(z1, zz1, p)
159:             let s1 := mulmod(y1, z2z2z2, p)
160:             let s2 := mulmod(y2, z1z1z1, p)
161: 
162:             let h_ := addmod(u2, sub(p, u1), p)
163:             let r_ := addmod(s2, sub(p, s1), p)
164: 
165:             // if h == 0 and r == 0, points are identical
166:             let hIsZero := iszero(h_)
167:             let rIsZero := iszero(r_)
168: 
169:             switch and(hIsZero, rIsZero)
170:             case 1 {
171:                 // Points are identical, perform doubling
172:                 let yy := mulmod(y1, y1, p)
173:                 let m := addmod(mulmod(3, mulmod(x1, x1, p), p), mulmod(a, mulmod(zz1, zz1, p), p), p)
174:                 let s := mulmod(4, mulmod(x1, yy, p), p)

176:                 ry := addmod(mulmod(m, addmod(s, sub(p, rx), p), p), sub(p, mulmod(8, mulmod(yy, yy, p), p)), p)
177:                 rz := mulmod(2, mulmod(y1, z1, p), p)

198:             let s := mulmod(4, mulmod(x, yy, p), p)

210:         for (uint256 i = 0; i < 128; i++) {

213:                 (x, y, z) = _jDouble(x, y, z);

216:             uint256 bits1 = (u1 >> 504) & 3;
217:             uint256 bits2 = (u2 >> 504) & 3;
218:             uint256 idx = bits1 * 4 + bits2;

220:             JPoint memory lookup = points[idx];

226:                     z = lookup.z;

229:                 }

232:             u1 <<= 2;
233:             u2 <<= 2;
234:         }

236:         return _affineFromJacobian(x, y, z);

In Jacobian coordinates:
- P1 = (x1, y1, z1)
- P2 = (x2, y2, z2) in affine (z2=1 typically in our case)
- For addition: u1 = x1 * z2^2, u2 = x2 * z1^2, s1 = y1 * z2^3, s2 = y2 * z1^3, h = u2 - u1, r = s2 - s1
- If h != 0: x3 = r^2 - h^3 - 2*u1*h^2, y3 = r*(u1*h^2 - x3) - s1*h^3, z3 = h*z1*z2
- If h == 0 and r == 0: points are identical, do doubling
